items.flavor: Kessler-Voss builds them pretty. I build the dents.
Redline is just a number somebody else wrote down.
Old habit: a spare mag in every pocket, one in the boot.
Odds are for other people. I brought a lucky bolt.
Corporate can bill me for the dent. A nice one.
Corporate packs light and files forms. I pack heavy.
One more hull patch and I count as company property.
Wrong place, wrong time. At least I pick the exit.
Every loose scrap has my name on it. Check the invoice.
Thinking later is a skill. I have practiced for years.
A fresh drill bit and a bad attitude. Standard Rigs kit.
Luck is just a plan nobody has checked yet.
Like in Road Worrier: tidy rows are just ammo waiting.
